instructions: Run the auto-merge command exactly as printed: `gh pr merge 42 --repo owner/repo --match-head-commit abc123 --auto --squash`.
Only if GitHub reports that auto-merge is unavailable, run the plain merge fallback: `gh pr merge 42 --repo owner/repo --match-head-commit abc123 --squash`.
If `gh` reports a GraphQL rate limit, run: `gh api -X PUT repos/owner/repo/pulls/42/merge -f sha=abc123 -f merge_method=squash`.
Then iterate immediately with the same options until the PR merges or needs work.
